label: dev-3
question: How many Sundays per year must an employee have off?

final.answer: At least 15 Sundays per year must remain free of employment (ArbZG § 11 para. 1). Sunday work that does occur must be compensated with a substitute rest day within the statutory period (ArbZG § 11 para. 3).

served: At least 15 Sundays per year must remain free of employment (ArbZG § 11 para. 1). Sunday work that does occur must be compensated with a substitute rest day within the statutory period (ArbZG § 11 para. 3).
